integrity: The proof reconstructs the two published condensation maps as relation-composition closure operators, proves an exact universal commutation criterion, identifies the common-bound relation with comparability components, and derives the finite endpoint characterization. The primary arXiv full text was inspected at the fusion-frame, p-condition, condensed/brilliant, condensation, and truth-preservation definitions and propositions. Candidate-specific published-finding and literature searches did not locate the interaction theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a structural statement about the two right-condensation relation operators. It does not claim preservation of the full bimodal language after applying both operations. The least/greatest-element characterization uses finiteness; only the relational commutation criterion extends unchanged to infinite preorders.
title: Finite criterion for commuting box and diamond condensations
